name: fisheries
description: Fisheries and Maritime Activity: from a vessel (IMO, register number, GFW vessel id), flag state, fishing area or species to RFMO authorised-vessel register entries with their history, IUU listings and delistings with verbatim reasons, Global Fishing Watch published fishing-effort aggregates and FAO FishStat catch statistics - each with source, snapshot or release, and as-of time - with reviewable vessel identity and citation links to sanctions, geospatial areas and, when composed, OSINT vessel movements and Agriculture & Food Systems records. No illegal-fishing inference, legality status or enforcement recommendation.

query_examples.intent: Authorisations and IUU listings of a vessel on a date
query_examples.semantics: authorisations and listings with register, snapshot revision and as-of time, the identity match that connected each, the identity history and the registers consulted; a vessel with no record has none on record in the covered registers, never legal or compliant

query_examples.intent: Effort and catch for an area
query_examples.semantics: GFW apparent fishing effort and FishStat catch side by side with releases, status flags, units and method notes; unpublished cells are not published, never zero; never combined into an indicator

exclusions: inferring illegal fishing from movement or effort patterns
legality or compliance status for any vessel
